headline: Veilfloat Build
title: Veilfloat Build | Swift Retreat and Lightning Healing | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Veilfloat is a Lightning support that you can catch at night on Tideblossom Coast, or evolve from Bulbly at level forty two. Swift Retreat dodges away and leaves a jellyfish clone that shocks and slows enemies. Hold Lightning Discharge to heal Lightning teammates. Guides pick Spirited Feather and Auspicious Bell as held items, with Blazen as a partner. Do you run Veilfloat? Comment below!
description: Veilfloat build in Aniimo: Lightning support, Swift Retreat plus Lightning Discharge, Spirited Feather and Auspicious Bell held items, Blazen as a partner. Found at night on Tideblossom Coast or evolved from Bulbly at level 42.
joke: Veilfloat heals the team and still looks like a floating nightlight.
